Chandler North Saturday Ride

Chandler, AZ · Road

Chandler North Saturday Ride is a road group ride in Chandler, AZ. It rolls every Saturday at 6:00 am from Global Bikes & E-Bikes Chandler. About 30–50 miles, a 22+ mph, B 18+ mph, C 15+ mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: a 22+ mph, B 18+ mph, C 15+ mph. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @globalbikes the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Chandler North Saturday Ride group ride

A Saturday shop ride with three pace groups. The C group holds a steady 15 mph and keeps the group together. Faster groups go longer. RSVP on the shop's Meetup, which has over 5,000 members.
